clue.text: Result of bone fusion — skill hid sores after surgery

parts.note: art is skill, as in the art of persuasion

parts.note: the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: A patient whose skill at concealment hid their sores until an operation fused the bone.
explanation.definitionFit: Arthrodesis is the surgical fixing of a joint so that its bones grow together, the stiffened joint being what fusion produces.

clue.text: Aniseed liquor turned up in tea, an Indian 'fiddle'?

taken as written
